One 8D per defect. Investigation INV-0142 covers batch stg-B0003 and has two 8D reports.

D1 · Team

Needs input
Add the team: quality engineer (owner), reflow process engineer, line supervisor.

D2 · Problem description

Auto-filled
On the night shift of 15 Oct 2026, 47 CTRL-BRD-A boards from batch stg-B0003 on SMT line 2 showed solder bridging. 44 of 47 were built 02:00–02:40. Batches stg-B0001 and stg-B0002 were not affected.

D3 · Containment

Auto-filled
112 boards built 02:00–02:40 passed AOI but were above USL on peak reflow temperature: quarantine finished goods and notify the customer about boards already shipped. Boards built outside 02:00–02:40 were in spec on peak reflow temperature. See the board list.

D4 · Root cause

Auto-filled
Occurrence
Peak reflow temperature was above USL 02:00–02:40 (257.9–259.8 °C, spec 245–255 °C), through the mechanism excess reflow spreading. 44 of 47 boards with solder bridging were built 02:00–02:40. Solder bridging rate, out of spec vs in spec: 28.2% vs 0.125% (226×).
Escape
Why did the line run 40 minutes on the wrong profile? Confirm whether recipe changes need sign-off and whether the oven has a peak-temperature alarm.
